title: Inflation report due Wednesday
summary: The government will publish September price numbers on Wednesday, Oct. 14. Forecasters expect yearly inflation to rise to about 3.6%, up from 3.4% in August, mostly because gasoline prices were very high. Until the real number comes out, this is only a guess.
why: Inflation is how fast prices go up. If it is higher than people expect, the Fed may keep interest rates high or raise them, and that usually makes stocks that cost a lot compared with their profits, like AMD, fall more.

title: Coming up: the Fed decides on rates Oct. 27-28
summary: Minutes from the Fed's last meeting showed that officials expect another rate increase may be needed this year. The next decision is at the end of October.
why: The Fed sets the rate banks charge each other, and that moves what everyone pays to borrow. Higher rates usually make bonds look better and can pull stock prices down.

title: Microsoft reportedly plans its own AI chip
summary: Press reports say Microsoft plans to show a new chip called Maia 300 and has talked with TSMC about making hundreds of thousands of them for 2027. Microsoft has not confirmed the timing, and reports disagree on when it will arrive.
why: If big companies build their own chips, they may buy fewer from NVIDIA over time. But TSMC would likely make the chips either way, so this is something to watch, not a sure thing.
